title: PVMatch: Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation for Photovoltaic Defects Using Dynamic Pseudo-Labeling and Multi-Scale Feature Consistency
mechanism: Class-aware dynamic thresholds keep rare EL defect classes in the pseudo-labels; a global-local feature consistency loss works inside masked defect regions.
adaptation: The only EL-specific SSL method found. Use it as a benchmark SSL baseline if code becomes available. The class-aware threshold could replace our fixed threshold for crack and inactive.
min_experiment: Benchmark arm only: reimplement CDT in our Mean Teacher code at 20% labels vs our Mean Teacher, 3 seeds. Metric: crack and inactive IoU. Kill if n.d.
evidence: R: real-world EL datasets, unnamed; no numbers in the abstract.
prior_overlap: Our Mean Teacher with hard/tolerant pseudo-labels was n.d. from 20% up. Class-aware thresholds were not tested, but they target the low-label regime. Mostly closed for scores.
